truth_classes.AUTHORITY_CURRENT: Live active-owner state, current topology/job/completion/retirement locks and evidence agree.
truth_classes.AUTHORITY_DELTA: Live owner state moved after the current selector; reconcile only the delta.
truth_classes.STALE_ARCHITECTURE_PENDING_RECONCILIATIO: Metadata conflicts with CURRENT-AUTHORITY-004 or its selected eight-peer topology/readiness state.
truth_classes.RETIRED_SYSTEM_RESURRECTION: Work attempts to create, dispatch, repair, qualify, research, telemeter, auto-provision or bind a successor for terminally retired PROSE.
truth_classes.JOB_LANE_VIOLATION: Work attempts to take another active system or named work program's product job or semantic authority outside an admitted interface.
truth_classes.FALSE_SYSTEM_COMPLETION: A phase, packet, test, branch or subsystem closure is used to claim completion of SYSTEM_MASTER or an active peer.
truth_classes.PROGRAMMING_SCOPE_DRIFT: Programming work is restarted, absorbed into another lane or treated as a peer without explicit admission.
truth_classes.FALSE_EXECUTION_READINESS: An architectural peer is dispatched without the current topology-required control and execution authority, or readiness metadata remains blocked after its required control record is established.
truth_classes.STALE_DELEGATION: Second Shift delegation does not match live owner control, current obligation, topology/job/completion locks or execution-ready peer coverage.
truth_classes.OVERLAPPING_MUTATION_CLAIM: More than one mutation-capable claim is live in the same active peer lane.
truth_classes.EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: Claimed standing exceeds exact subject/receipt/artifact evidence.
truth_classes.HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED: Machine-readable authority cannot select among valid product choices.
truth_classes.AUTHOR_DECISION_REQUIRED: Progress requires author authority automation cannot synthesize.
truth_classes.PRIVATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires private data authority not granted.
truth_classes.NATIVE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires native device/platform evidence not available.
truth_classes.EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires external provider/publication/certification authority not granted by repository evidence.

write_rules: Historical evidence and exact-SHA receipts remain append-only.
PROSE may be described only as historically complete and terminally retired for current execution.
All eight active peers remain in their own product lanes and integrate upward through explicit System Master/shared interfaces without ownership transfer.
BOOK is the only owner of genuinely unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability; DOCUMENTS receives none of that work.
PROGRAMMING remains a distinct active work program and is not a peer until explicit admission.
Repository execution readiness never grants human, author, private, native, external, publication, production or user-action authority.
Changed integration/control subjects require fresh evidence; no PASS transfers across changed SHA, topology, subject, readiness or ownership boundaries.
Auto-provisioning can fill missing execution coverage only for an already-declared execution-ready peer; it cannot create a system or resurrect a retired system.
